booking_events.title: J5 vs J6 booking, read as the PRD asks
booking_events.sql:
WITH first_co AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, TIMESTAMP AS T, COST_BREAKDOWN_FLOW AS FLOW
  FROM PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CUSTOMER_API.CLEVERTAP_EVENTS
  WHERE EVENT_NAME = 'checkout_page_loaded' AND TIMESTAMP >= '{{booking_since}}' AND USER_ID IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY USER_ID ORDER BY TIMESTAMP) = 1
), cohort AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, T, LEFT(FLOW, 2) AS ARM FROM first_co WHERE FLOW IN ('J5N','J5R','J6N','J6R')
), fee AS (
  SELECT e.USER_ID, MIN(e.TIMESTAMP) AS FT
  FROM PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CUSTOMER_API.CLEVERTAP_EVENTS e JOIN cohort c ON c.USER_ID = e.USER_ID AND e.TIMESTAMP >= c.T
  WHERE e.EVENT_NAME = 'booking_fee_captured' AND e.TIMESTAMP >= '{{booking_since}}'
  GROUP BY 1
), steps AS (
  SELECT c.ARM, c.USER_ID, c.T AS ST, 'checkout_page_loaded' AS EVENT, c.T AS ET FROM cohort c
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.ARM, c.USER_ID, c.T, 'booking_fee_captured', f.FT FROM cohort c JOIN fee f ON f.USER_ID = c.USER_ID
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.ARM, c.USER_ID, c.T, e.EVENT_NAME, e.TIMESTAMP
  FROM cohort c JOIN fee f ON f.USER_ID = c.USER_ID
  JOIN PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CUSTOMER_API.CLEVERTAP_EVENTS e ON e.USER_ID = c.USER_ID AND e.TIMESTAMP >= f.FT
   AND TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(e.TIMESTAMP) < DATEADD(day, 7, TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(f.FT))
  WHERE e.TIMESTAMP >= '{{booking_since}}'
    AND e.EVENT_NAME IN ('save_address_page_loaded','landmark_type_page_loaded','address_confirmed','install_date_page_loaded','install_date_confirmed','booking_confirmed')
), rel AS (
  SELECT MIN(TO_DATE(LEFT(T, 10))) AS R FROM cohort WHERE ARM = 'J6'
), wins AS (
  SELECT 'd7' AS WIN, 7 AS N UNION ALL SELECT 'd30', 30
)
SELECT ARM, 'all' AS WIN, EVENT, COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) AS USERS FROM steps GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
UNION ALL
SELECT s.ARM, wins.WIN, s.EVENT, COUNT(DISTINCT s.USER_ID)
FROM steps s CROSS JOIN rel JOIN wins
  ON rel.R IS NOT NULL AND TO_DATE(LEFT(s.ST, 10)) >= rel.R
 AND TO_DATE(LEFT(s.ST, 10)) < DATEADD(day, wins.N, rel.R) AND TO_DATE(LEFT(s.ET, 10)) < DATEADD(day, wins.N, rel.R)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'J6', '__release', TO_VARCHAR(R, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 0 FROM rel WHERE R IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1, 2, 4 DESC

builds.title: Customers per day by app build
builds.sql:
SELECT LEFT(TIMESTAMP, 10) AS DAY, APP_VERSION, COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) AS USERS, MAX(TIMESTAMP) AS LAST_SEEN
FROM PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CUSTOMER_API.CLEVERTAP_EVENTS
WHERE TIMESTAMP >= '{{st_since}}' AND APP_VERSION >= '2026_11_06' AND APP_VERSION < '2027'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

feature_events.title: Wiom TV gift + R-day survey events
feature_events.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, EVENT_NAME AS EV, LEFT(TIMESTAMP, 10) AS DAY
  FROM PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CUSTOMER_API.CLEVERTAP_EVENTS
  WHERE TIMESTAMP >= TO_VARCHAR(DATEADD(day, -30, LEAST(TO_DATE('{{st_since}}'), TO_DATE('{{tv_release}}'), TO_DATE('{{survey_release}}'))), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND EVENT_NAME IN ('chat_open_wiom_tv_clicked','manage_wiom_tv_clicked','wiom_tv_reward_page_loaded','wiom_tv_reward_box_tapped','wiom_tv_reward_sheet_shown','wiom_tv_reward_watch_clicked','wiom_tv_reward_open_failed','chat_open_wiom_tv_failed','manage_wiom_tv_open_failed','wiom_tv_reward_close_clicked','wiom_tv_promo_sheet_shown','wiom_tv_promo_sheet_expanded','wiom_tv_watch_free_clicked','wiom_tv_stream_failed','r9_survey_q1_loaded','r9_survey_difficulty_loaded','r9_survey_reason_loaded','r9_survey_response_recorded','r9_survey_ending_loaded','r9_survey_ending_cta_clicked','r9_survey_closed','r9_survey_save_failed')
), ev AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, EV, DAY FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT USER_ID, 'r9_survey_q2_loaded', DAY FROM base WHERE EV IN ('r9_survey_difficulty_loaded','r9_survey_reason_loaded')
), w AS (
  SELECT ev.*, TO_DATE(DAY) AS D,
         IFF(EV LIKE 'r9_%', TO_DATE('{{survey_release}}'), TO_DATE('{{tv_release}}')) AS R,
         EV IN ('wiom_tv_promo_sheet_shown','wiom_tv_promo_sheet_expanded','wiom_tv_watch_free_clicked','wiom_tv_stream_failed') AS OLD
  FROM ev
), wins AS (
  SELECT 'd7' AS WIN, 7 AS N UNION ALL SELECT 'd30', 30
)
SELECT EV AS EVENT, DAY, COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) AS USERS FROM ev WHERE DAY >= '{{st_since}}' GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT EV, 'all', COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) FROM ev WHERE DAY >= '{{st_since}}' GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT w.EV, wins.WIN, COUNT(DISTINCT w.USER_ID) FROM w JOIN wins
  ON (NOT w.OLD AND w.D >= w.R AND w.D < DATEADD(day, wins.N, w.R))
  OR (w.OLD AND w.D < w.R AND w.D >= DATEADD(day, -wins.N, w.R))
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT '__release_tv', '{{tv_release}}', 0
UNION ALL
SELECT '__release_survey', '{{survey_release}}', 0
ORDER BY 1, 2

freshness.title: How fresh the numbers are
freshness.sql:
-- When the numbers were fetched, and how fresh each source is (all IST).
SELECT TO_VARCHAR(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS FETCHED,
  (SELECT MAX(TIMESTAMP) FROM PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CUSTOMER_API.CLEVERTAP_EVENTS
     WHERE TIMESTAMP >= TO_VARCHAR(DATEADD(day, -3, CURRENT_DATE()), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS APP_UP_TO,
  (SELECT TO_VARCHAR(MAX(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', _FIVETRAN_SYNCED))::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CUSTOMER_API.CLEVERTAP_EVENTS
     WHERE TIMESTAMP >= TO_VARCHAR(DATEADD(day, -3, CURRENT_DATE()), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS APP_LOADED,
  (SELECT TO_VARCHAR(MAX(DATEADD('second', 19800, added_time)), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.BOOKINGVANILLA_AUDIT
     WHERE event_name = 'booking_fee_captured' AND added_time >= DATEADD(day, -2, CURRENT_DATE())) AS PAY_UP_TO,
  (SELECT TO_VARCHAR(MAX(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', _FIVETRAN_SYNCED))::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.FUTWORK_CALLS_DATA
     WHERE UPLOADED_AT >= DATEADD(day, -3, CURRENT_DATE())) AS FW_UP_TO

funnel_daily.title: Installs and the screens they reached
funnel_daily.sql:
WITH inst AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, MIN(TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(TIMESTAMP)) AS T
  FROM PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CUSTOMER_API.CLEVERTAP_EVENTS
  WHERE EVENT_NAME = 'App Installed' AND TIMESTAMP >= '{{since}}' AND USER_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
), ev AS (
  SELECT e.USER_ID, e.EVENT_NAME AS EV,
    MAX_BY(NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(e.COST_BREAKDOWN_FLOW)), ''), 'UNDEFINED'), 'NULL'), IFF(NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(e.COST_BREAKDOWN_FLOW)), ''), 'UNDEFINED'), 'NULL') IS NULL, NULL, TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(e.TIMESTAMP))) AS F,
    MAX(IFF(NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(e.COST_BREAKDOWN_FLOW)), ''), 'UNDEFINED'), 'NULL') IS NULL, NULL, TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(e.TIMESTAMP))) AS FT
  FROM PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CUSTOMER_API.CLEVERTAP_EVENTS e
  JOIN inst i ON i.USER_ID = e.USER_ID
  WHERE e.TIMESTAMP >= '{{since}}'
    AND e.EVENT_NAME IN ('booking_homepage_loaded', 'phone_number_submit_clicked', 'phone_number_verified_page_loaded', 'how_does_it_work_page_loaded', 'recharge_slider_page_loaded', 'final_booking_cost_page_loaded', 'checking_serviceablity_page_loaded', 'serviceable_page_loaded', 'unserviceable_page_loaded', 'choose_different_location_clicked', 'checkout_page_loaded', 'juspay_checkout_page_loaded', 'payment_failed_page_loaded', 'booking_fee_captured', 'install_date_page_loaded', 'install_date_confirmed', 'save_address_page_loaded', 'landmark_type_page_loaded', 'landmark_page_loaded', 'voice_recording_page_loaded', 'address_confirmed', 'booking_confirmed', 'login_karein_clicked', 'existing_connection_page_loaded', 'renewal_fee_captured')
    AND TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(e.TIMESTAMP) >= i.T
    AND TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(e.TIMESTAMP) < DATEADD(day, {{days}}, i.T)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), fl AS (
  -- The flow variant the app last reported for this customer in the window (cost_breakdown_flow).
  SELECT USER_ID, MAX_BY(F, FT) AS FLOW FROM ev WHERE F IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
), cohort AS (
  SELECT i.USER_ID, TO_VARCHAR(i.T::DATE) AS DAY, COALESCE(f.FLOW, 'NOT ASSIGNED') AS FLOW,
    IFF(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ev o WHERE o.USER_ID = i.USER_ID AND o.EV IN ('login_karein_clicked', 'existing_connection_page_loaded', 'renewal_fee_captured')), 'existing', 'new') AS KIND
  FROM inst i LEFT JOIN fl f ON f.USER_ID = i.USER_ID
), segs AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, DAY, FLOW, 'all' AS SEG FROM cohort
  UNION ALL SELECT USER_ID, DAY, FLOW, 'new' FROM cohort WHERE KIND = 'new'
), bk AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT USER_ID FROM ev WHERE EV = 'booking_confirmed'
), s AS (
  SELECT g.DAY, g.SEG, g.FLOW, g.USER_ID, ev.EV, (b.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) AS BK FROM segs g LEFT JOIN ev ON ev.USER_ID = g.USER_ID LEFT JOIN bk b ON b.USER_ID = g.USER_ID
)
SELECT s.DAY, s.SEG, s.FLOW, COUNT(DISTINCT s.USER_ID) AS "installs",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'booking_homepage_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "booking_homepage_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'phone_number_submit_clicked', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "phone_number_submit_clicked",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'phone_number_verified_page_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "phone_number_verified_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'how_does_it_work_page_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "how_does_it_work_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'recharge_slider_page_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "recharge_slider_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'final_booking_cost_page_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "final_booking_cost_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'checking_serviceablity_page_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "checking_serviceablity_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'serviceable_page_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "serviceable_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'unserviceable_page_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "unserviceable_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'choose_different_location_clicked', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "choose_different_location_clicked",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'checkout_page_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "checkout_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'juspay_checkout_page_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "juspay_checkout_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'payment_failed_page_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "payment_failed_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'booking_fee_captured', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "booking_fee_captured",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'install_date_page_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "install_date_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'install_date_confirmed', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "install_date_confirmed",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'save_address_page_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "save_address_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'landmark_type_page_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "landmark_type_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'landmark_page_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "landmark_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'voice_recording_page_loaded', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "voice_recording_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'address_confirmed', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "address_confirmed",

  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'login_karein_clicked', s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "login_karein_clicked",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'booking_homepage_loaded' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_booking_homepage_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'phone_number_submit_clicked' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_phone_number_submit_clicked",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'how_does_it_work_page_loaded' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_how_does_it_work_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'recharge_slider_page_loaded' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_recharge_slider_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'final_booking_cost_page_loaded' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_final_booking_cost_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'checking_serviceablity_page_loaded' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_checking_serviceablity_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'serviceable_page_loaded' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_serviceable_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'checkout_page_loaded' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_checkout_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'juspay_checkout_page_loaded' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_juspay_checkout_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'booking_fee_captured' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_booking_fee_captured",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'install_date_page_loaded' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_install_date_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'install_date_confirmed' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_install_date_confirmed",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'save_address_page_loaded' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_save_address_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'landmark_type_page_loaded' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_landmark_type_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'landmark_page_loaded' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_landmark_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'voice_recording_page_loaded' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_voice_recording_page_loaded",
  COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(s.EV = 'address_confirmed' AND s.BK, s.USER_ID, NULL)) AS "bk_address_confirmed"
FROM s GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

fw_pb.title: Futwork calls to customers who paid but haven't submitted their address
fw_pb.sql:
-- Futwork "Post Booking Fee" calling (teleproject 67cff777b4f6ef00147e71b1): customers who paid the booking fee and
-- chose a date but had not submitted their address are handed to Futwork. One row per lead (mobile x hand-over day, as Futwork counts).
-- Source: PUBLIC.FUTWORK_CALLS_DATA (Futwork webhook, synced hourly) + PUBLIC.BOOKINGVANILLA_AUDIT (backend booking events, +5:30 = IST).
-- Address submitted = an address_updated event after the booking-fee payment that made them a lead (same as the
-- Futwork sheet's "fee status is now Address submitted"). Cost = Futwork talk minutes x Rs 3.75, pre-GST.
WITH calls AS (
  SELECT RIGHT(TO_VARCHAR(MOBILE), 10) AS MOB,
         CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', UPLOADED_AT)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS UT,
         START_TIME AS ST, COALESCE(CONVERSATION_MINUTES, 0) AS CM, OUTCOME:title::STRING AS T
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.FUTWORK_CALLS_DATA
  WHERE TELEPROJECT = '67cff777b4f6ef00147e71b1' AND MOBILE IS NOT NULL
    AND UPLOADED_AT >= '2026-10-01'  -- the project started 29 Oct 2026; keep every lead
), leads AS (
  SELECT MOB, DATE(UT) AS D, MIN(UT) AS UT,
         COUNT(ST) AS CALLS,
         SUM(CM) AS MINS,
         MIN(ST) AS FIRST_CALL,
         MIN(IFF(CM > 0, ST, NULL)) AS FIRST_CONN,
         MAX_BY(T, COALESCE(ST, UT)) AS LAST_OUTCOME,
         MAX(IFF(T = 'Setup Booking Completed On Call', 1, 0)) AS DONE_ON_CALL
  FROM calls GROUP BY 1, 2
), ev AS (
  SELECT RIGHT(TO_VARCHAR(mobile), 10) AS MOB, event_name AS E, DATEADD('second', 19800, added_time) AS T
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.BOOKINGVANILLA_AUDIT
  WHERE added_time >= '2026-09-15'
    AND event_name IN ('booking_fee_captured', 'address_updated', 'refunded', 'refund_initiated')
), fee AS (
  SELECT l.MOB, l.D, MAX(e.T) AS FT
  FROM leads l JOIN ev e ON e.MOB = l.MOB AND e.E = 'booking_fee_captured' AND e.T <= DATEADD(hour, 1, l.UT)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), x AS (
  SELECT l.*, f.FT,
         MIN(IFF(e.E = 'address_updated' AND e.T > f.FT, e.T, NULL)) AS ADDR_T,
         MIN(IFF(e.E IN ('refunded', 'refund_initiated') AND e.T > f.FT, e.T, NULL)) AS REF_T
  FROM leads l LEFT JOIN fee f ON f.MOB = l.MOB AND f.D = l.D LEFT JOIN ev e ON e.MOB = l.MOB
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT TO_VARCHAR(UT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DAY,
       TO_VARCHAR(FT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS PAID_AT,
       TO_VARCHAR(UT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS GIVEN_AT,
       TO_VARCHAR(FIRST_CALL, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS FIRST_CALL_AT,
       TO_VARCHAR(FIRST_CONN, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS FIRST_CONNECT_AT,
       TO_VARCHAR(ADDR_T, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ADDRESS_AT,
       IFF(REF_T IS NOT NULL AND (ADDR_T IS NULL OR REF_T < ADDR_T), 1, 0) AS REFUNDED,
       CALLS, MINS, LAST_OUTCOME, DONE_ON_CALL
FROM x
ORDER BY 1, 3

goal_addr.title: Booking-fee payers and address submission
goal_addr.sql:
-- Customers who paid the booking fee each day (IST) and whether they submitted their address afterwards.
-- Paid = BOOKINGVANILLA_AUDIT booking_fee_captured (test numbers dropped, as Metabase dashboard 1280).
-- Address submitted = an address_updated event after that payment, split by how soon. Refunded without an address is counted too.
WITH paid AS (
  SELECT RIGHT(TO_VARCHAR(mobile), 10) AS MOB, DATE(DATEADD('second', 19800, added_time)) AS DT, MIN(DATEADD('second', 19800, added_time)) AS PT
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.BOOKINGVANILLA_AUDIT
  WHERE event_name = 'booking_fee_captured' AND mobile > '5999999999' AND added_time >= '2026-09-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), ev AS (
  SELECT RIGHT(TO_VARCHAR(mobile), 10) AS MOB, event_name AS E, DATEADD('second', 19800, added_time) AS T
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.BOOKINGVANILLA_AUDIT
  WHERE added_time >= '2026-09-01' AND event_name IN ('address_updated', 'refunded', 'refund_initiated')
), x AS (
  SELECT p.DT, p.MOB, p.PT,
    MIN(IFF(e.E = 'address_updated' AND e.T >= p.PT, e.T, NULL)) AS AT,
    MIN(IFF(e.E IN ('refunded', 'refund_initiated') AND e.T >= p.PT, e.T, NULL)) AS RT
  FROM paid p LEFT JOIN ev e ON e.MOB = p.MOB
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT TO_VARCHAR(DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DAY, COUNT(*) AS PAID,
  COUNT_IF(AT IS NOT NULL) AS ADDRESS_EVER,
  COUNT_IF(AT < DATEADD(day, 1, PT)) AS ADDRESS_1D,
  COUNT_IF(AT < DATEADD(day, 7, PT)) AS ADDRESS_7D,
  COUNT_IF(AT IS NULL AND RT IS NOT NULL) AS REFUNDED_NO_ADDRESS
FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

goal_calls.title: Calls to Wiom vs the engineer, engineer assigned to install
goal_calls.sql:
-- Calls between engineer assignment and installation, per call day (IST). Matches the data science team's
-- October figure exactly (5,239 calls to Wiom).
-- Window per connection: DBT.COMPANY_B_CONNECTION_BOOKING_ENRICHED ASSIGNED_TIME -> INSTALL_TIME (still open if not installed).
-- Calls to Wiom = distinct customer inbound calls to Wiom's support IVR (CUSTOMER_INBOUND_CALL_LOG).
-- Calls to the engineer = distinct masked-number calls from the customer to their CSP (USER_CONNECTION_CALL_LOGS);
-- "missed" = MISSED_CALL (no answer).
WITH coh AS (
  SELECT CONNECTION_ID, RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(TO_VARCHAR(MOBILE), '[^0-9]', ''), 10) AS M10,
         ASSIGNED_TIME AS A, COALESCE(INSTALL_TIME, '2099-01-01'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS I
  FROM PROD_DB.DBT.COMPANY_B_CONNECTION_BOOKING_ENRICHED
  WHERE ASSIGNED_TIME IS NOT NULL AND ASSIGNED_TIME >= '2026-08-15'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CONNECTION_ID ORDER BY ASSIGNED_TIME DESC) = 1
), ib AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT x.CALL_ID, x.M10, x.T
  FROM (SELECT CALL_ID, RIGHT(TO_VARCHAR(FROM_NUMBER), 10) AS M10, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', CREATED_AT)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS T
        FROM PROD_DB.POSTGRES_RDS_PARTNER_CALL_LOG_IVR.CUSTOMER_INBOUND_CALL_LOG WHERE CREATED_AT >= '2026-09-01') x
  JOIN coh c ON c.M10 = x.M10 AND x.T BETWEEN c.A AND c.I
), uc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT x.CALL_ID, x.M10, x.T, x.S
  FROM (SELECT CALL_ID, RIGHT(TO_VARCHAR(FROM_NUMBER), 10) AS M10, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', CREATED_AT)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS T, CALL_STATUS AS S
        FROM PROD_DB.POSTGRES_RDS_PARTNER_CALL_LOG_IVR.USER_CONNECTION_CALL_LOGS WHERE CREATED_AT >= '2026-09-01' AND NOT _FIVETRAN_DELETED) x
  JOIN coh c ON c.M10 = x.M10 AND x.T BETWEEN c.A AND c.I
), d AS (
  SELECT TO_VARCHAR(DATE(T), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DAY, 'wiom' AS K, COUNT(*) AS CALLS, COUNT(DISTINCT M10) AS CUSTOMERS, 0 AS MISSED FROM ib GROUP BY 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT TO_VARCHAR(DATE(T), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'csp', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT M10), COUNT_IF(S = 'MISSED_CALL') FROM uc GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT DAY,
  SUM(IFF(K = 'wiom', CALLS, 0)) AS WIOM_CALLS, SUM(IFF(K = 'wiom', CUSTOMERS, 0)) AS WIOM_CUSTOMERS,
  SUM(IFF(K = 'csp', CALLS, 0)) AS CSP_CALLS, SUM(IFF(K = 'csp', MISSED, 0)) AS CSP_MISSED
FROM d GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

pay_daily.title: Booking fee paid and booked, each payment day, by flow
pay_daily.sql:
-- Each payment day (IST): customers who paid the booking fee, and how many got a confirmed booking.
-- Same sources as Metabase dashboard 1280: BOOKINGVANILLA_AUDIT booking_fee_captured (mobile > 5999999999 drops tests)
-- and DBT.FCT_BOOKING_WINDOW booking_confirm_date. Flow = the app's cost_breakdown_flow on the customer's
-- first payment summary in the 30 days up to the payment (the PRD's rule); no app tag = paid without one (web, call centre, or never tagged).
-- INST: 'in_range' = app installed on or after the funnel's "Installed from" date; 'earlier' = installed before it (or no install seen).
-- ARM '__BOOKED_ALL' rows = everyone with a booking confirmed that day, paid that day or not (Metabase's UNIQUE_CX_BOOKED).
WITH paid AS (
  SELECT DATE(DATEADD('second', 19800, added_time)) AS DT, RIGHT(TO_VARCHAR(mobile), 10) AS MOB,
         MIN(DATEADD('second', 19800, added_time)) AS PT
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.BOOKINGVANILLA_AUDIT
  WHERE event_name = 'booking_fee_captured' AND mobile > '5999999999'
    AND DATE(DATEADD('second', 19800, added_time)) >= TO_VARCHAR(LEAST(TO_DATE('{{booking_since}}'), TO_DATE('{{since}}')), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), co AS (
  SELECT RIGHT(MOBILE, 10) AS MOB, TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(TIMESTAMP) AS TS, UPPER(TRIM(COST_BREAKDOWN_FLOW)) AS F
  FROM PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CUSTOMER_API.CLEVERTAP_EVENTS
  WHERE EVENT_NAME = 'checkout_page_loaded' AND MOBILE IS NOT NULL
    AND TIMESTAMP >= TO_VARCHAR(DATEADD(day, -30, LEAST(TO_DATE('{{booking_since}}'), TO_DATE('{{since}}'))), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND NULLIF(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(COST_BREAKDOWN_FLOW)), ''), 'UNDEFINED') IS NOT NULL
), inst AS (
  -- Customers whose app was installed on or after the funnel's "Installed from" date.
  SELECT DISTINCT RIGHT(MOBILE, 10) AS MOB
  FROM PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CUSTOMER_API.CLEVERTAP_EVENTS
  WHERE EVENT_NAME = 'App Installed' AND TIMESTAMP >= '{{since}}' AND MOBILE IS NOT NULL
), arm AS (
  SELECT p.DT, p.MOB, MIN_BY(c.F, c.TS) AS F
  FROM paid p LEFT JOIN co c ON c.MOB = p.MOB AND c.TS <= DATEADD(minute, 30, p.PT) AND c.TS >= DATEADD(day, -30, p.PT)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), booked AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT booking_confirm_date AS BD, RIGHT(TO_VARCHAR(mobile), 10) AS MOB
  FROM PROD_DB.DBT.FCT_BOOKING_WINDOW
  WHERE booking_confirm_date >= TO_VARCHAR(LEAST(TO_DATE('{{booking_since}}'), TO_DATE('{{since}}')), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
), booked_paid AS (
  SELECT b.BD, b.MOB, MAX(IFF(p.MOB IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) AS PAID_SAME
  FROM booked b LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.MOB = b.MOB AND p.DT = b.BD
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), flags AS (
  SELECT a.DT, a.MOB,
         CASE WHEN a.F LIKE 'J6%' THEN 'J6' WHEN a.F LIKE 'J5%' THEN 'J5' WHEN a.F IS NULL THEN 'No app tag' ELSE 'Other' END AS ARM,
         MAX(IFF(b.BD = a.DT, 1, 0)) AS SAME,
         MAX(IFF(b.BD < DATEADD(day, 7, a.DT), 1, 0)) AS D7,
         MAX(IFF(b.BD IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) AS EVER,
         MAX(IFF(i.MOB IS NOT NULL, 'in_range', 'earlier')) AS INST
  FROM arm a LEFT JOIN booked b ON b.MOB = a.MOB AND b.BD >= a.DT
  LEFT JOIN inst i ON i.MOB = a.MOB
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT TO_VARCHAR(DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DAY, ARM, INST, COUNT(*) AS PAID,
       SUM(SAME) AS BOOKED_SAME_DAY, SUM(D7) AS BOOKED_7D, SUM(EVER) AS BOOKED_EVER
FROM flags GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
UNION ALL
SELECT TO_VARCHAR(BD, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '__BOOKED_ALL', '', COUNT(*), SUM(PAID_SAME), 0, 0 FROM booked_paid
WHERE BD <= DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

reach.title: Who was sent each message, and how far they got
reach.sql:
WITH sent AS (
  SELECT h.WORKFLOW_NAME AS WF, RIGHT(u.MOBILE, 10) AS MOB,
         MIN(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', h.CREATED_AT))::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS T
  FROM PROD_DB.MESSAGE_ORCHESTRATOR_SERVICE_AUDIT_PUBLIC.MESSAGE_HISTORY h
  JOIN PROD_DB.MESSAGE_ORCHESTRATOR_SERVICE_AUDIT_PUBLIC.USERS u ON u.ID = h.MAPPED_USER_ID AND u._FIVETRAN_ACTIVE
  WHERE h._FIVETRAN_ACTIVE AND h.CREATED_AT >= LEAST(TO_DATE('{{st_since}}'), TO_DATE('{{tv_release}}'), TO_DATE('{{survey_release}}'))
    AND h.WORKFLOW_NAME IN ('wiom_tv_install_gift', 'wiom_tv_recharge_gift', 'wiom_tv_link_reply', 'renewal_post_expiry_r9')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), ev AS (
  SELECT RIGHT(MOBILE, 10) AS MOB, EVENT_NAME, TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(TIMESTAMP) AS TS,
         PROPERTIES:"event_props.workflow_triggered"::STRING AS WFT,
         PROPERTIES:"event_props.cta_text"::STRING AS CTA,
         PROPERTIES:"event_props.ending"::STRING AS ENDING
  FROM PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CUSTOMER_API.CLEVERTAP_EVENTS
  WHERE TIMESTAMP >= TO_VARCHAR(LEAST(TO_DATE('{{st_since}}'), TO_DATE('{{tv_release}}'), TO_DATE('{{survey_release}}')), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND MOBILE IS NOT NULL
    AND EVENT_NAME IN ('chat_screen_loaded', 'message_from_wiom_delivered', 'wiom_message_cta_clicked',
      'wiom_tv_reward_page_loaded', 'wiom_tv_reward_box_tapped', 'wiom_tv_reward_sheet_shown', 'wiom_tv_reward_watch_clicked', 'wiom_tv_reward_open_failed',
      'r9_survey_q1_loaded', 'r9_survey_difficulty_loaded', 'r9_survey_reason_loaded', 'r9_survey_response_recorded', 'r9_survey_ending_loaded', 'r9_survey_closed')
), hit AS (
  SELECT s.WF, s.MOB, s.T, e.TS AS TT,
    CASE
      WHEN e.EVENT_NAME = 'chat_screen_loaded' THEN 'chat_opened'
      WHEN e.EVENT_NAME = 'message_from_wiom_delivered' AND e.WFT = s.WF THEN 'message_seen'
      WHEN e.EVENT_NAME = 'wiom_message_cta_clicked' AND s.WF IN ('wiom_tv_install_gift', 'wiom_tv_recharge_gift') AND e.CTA IN ('तोहफ़ा देखें', 'View your gift') THEN 'cta_tapped'
      WHEN e.EVENT_NAME = 'wiom_message_cta_clicked' AND s.WF = 'wiom_tv_link_reply' AND (e.CTA ILIKE '%wiom tv%' OR e.CTA ILIKE '%व्योम%') THEN 'cta_tapped'
      WHEN e.EVENT_NAME = 'wiom_message_cta_clicked' AND s.WF = 'renewal_post_expiry_r9' AND e.CTA = 'recharge_survey' THEN 'cta_tapped'
      WHEN e.EVENT_NAME LIKE 'wiom_tv_reward%' AND s.WF IN ('wiom_tv_install_gift', 'wiom_tv_recharge_gift') THEN e.EVENT_NAME
      WHEN e.EVENT_NAME IN ('r9_survey_difficulty_loaded', 'r9_survey_reason_loaded') AND s.WF = 'renewal_post_expiry_r9' THEN 'r9_survey_q2_loaded'
      WHEN e.EVENT_NAME = 'r9_survey_response_recorded' AND s.WF = 'renewal_post_expiry_r9' THEN 'ending:' || COALESCE(e.ENDING, '?')
      WHEN e.EVENT_NAME LIKE 'r9_survey%' AND s.WF = 'renewal_post_expiry_r9' THEN e.EVENT_NAME
    END AS STAGE
  FROM sent s JOIN ev e ON e.MOB = s.MOB AND e.TS >= s.T
), rows0 AS (
  SELECT WF, 'sent' AS STAGE, MOB, T, T AS TT FROM sent
  UNION ALL SELECT WF, 'message_seen', MOB, T, TT FROM hit WHERE STAGE = 'cta_tapped'
  UNION ALL SELECT WF, 'r9_survey_response_recorded', MOB, T, TT FROM hit WHERE STAGE LIKE 'ending:%'
  UNION ALL SELECT WF, STAGE, MOB, T, TT FROM hit WHERE STAGE IS NOT NULL
), all_rows AS (
  SELECT r.*, IFF(WF LIKE 'wiom_tv%', TO_DATE('{{tv_release}}'), TO_DATE('{{survey_release}}'))::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS R FROM rows0 r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'wiom_tv', STAGE, MOB, T, TT, TO_DATE('{{tv_release}}')::TIMESTAMP_NTZ FROM rows0 WHERE WF IN ('wiom_tv_install_gift', 'wiom_tv_recharge_gift')
), wins AS (
  SELECT 'd7' AS WIN, 7 AS N UNION ALL SELECT 'd30', 30
)
SELECT WF, 'all' AS WIN, STAGE, COUNT(DISTINCT MOB) AS USERS FROM all_rows GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
UNION ALL
SELECT a.WF, wins.WIN, a.STAGE, COUNT(DISTINCT a.MOB) FROM all_rows a JOIN wins
  ON a.T >= a.R AND a.T < DATEADD(day, wins.N, a.R) AND a.TT < DATEADD(day, wins.N, a.R)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
UNION ALL
SELECT WF, 'all', 'sent_day:' || LEFT(T::STRING, 10), COUNT(DISTINCT MOB) FROM sent GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
